title.zh: 列表里勾选了两条，导出时到底是哪两条
title.en: Which records get exported after selecting two rows?

summary.zh: 结合禾镜 v1.9.2 和学院归档的最新代码，梳理筛选、分页、跨页勾选与导出范围。
summary.en: A code review of filtering, pagination, selection across pages and export scope in FieldLens v1.9.2 and the archive demo.

basis.zh: 整理于 2026-11-10，依据 FieldLens 提交 9bb00ac 和 college-archive-demo 提交 cca79fe 的源码。文中的演示数据为预置样例；末节列出建议验证的情况，不表示本次完成了两个项目的全部回归测试。
basis.en: Compiled on 10 November 2026 from FieldLens commit 9bb00ac and college-archive-demo commit cca79fe. The public demos use preset data. The final section proposes checks rather than claiming a complete regression run for both projects.

title.zh: 先看按钮会处理哪些记录
title.en: Start with the records an action will affect

paragraphs.zh: 看这次禾镜的代码，值得记下来的是导出按钮上的数量。没勾选时，CSV 和报告处理全部筛选结果；勾选之后，处理当前筛选范围内的所选记录。按钮也随之变成“导出所选 CSV（2）”。读者不用猜“导出”指的是本页、全部数据，还是刚才勾选的两条。
paragraphs.en: One useful detail in the FieldLens update is the count on the export button. With no selection, CSV and report actions use all matching records. With a selection, they use the selected records within the current filter. The button changes to “Export selected CSV (2)”, making its scope visible.

paragraphs.zh: 这是一个具体的产品约定。换到删除、发通知或批量审批，零勾选时直接处理全部结果通常不合适。复用表格组件时，操作范围也需要重新确定，不能只把按钮名字换掉。
paragraphs.en: This is a product decision for export. For deletion, notifications or bulk approval, applying an action to every result when nothing is selected would usually be inappropriate. Reusing a table therefore requires another decision about action scope.

title.zh: 分页只改变眼前这一页

paragraphs.zh: 禾镜用 Set 保存记录 ID，翻页时保留选择；“选择本页”只操作当前页的记录。切换筛选后，代码会移除不再匹配的已选 ID。因此，这里允许跨页勾选，但不保留筛选范围之外的选择。这个规则应该写在操作反馈里。
paragraphs.en: FieldLens stores selected record IDs in a Set and keeps them when changing pages. “Select this page” affects only visible rows. Refreshing the filter removes selected IDs that no longer match. Selection crosses pages but stays within the active filter.

paragraphs.zh: 下面节选的是原有动作范围逻辑。调用前，refresh 已经清理失效的选择。如果把这行代码单独搬走，漏掉清理步骤，数量、按钮文案和实际导出的记录就可能对不上。
paragraphs.en: The following excerpt resolves the action scope. Before it runs, refresh has removed selections outside the filter. Copying this line without that cleanup could leave the count, button label and exported records inconsistent.

title.zh: 筛选条件变了，页码也要跟着变
title.en: Reset or clamp the page when results change

paragraphs.zh: 学院归档的列表按状态、分类和关键词组合筛选，再排序，最后按每页 12 条截取。筛选和排序变化时回到第一页；记录数量变化时，把当前页限制在剩余页数以内。这两处处理解决的是不同问题。
paragraphs.en: The archive list combines status, category and keyword filters, sorts the result, then takes a page of twelve records. Filter or sort changes reset the page to one. A change in result count clamps it to the remaining page range. These handle different situations.

paragraphs.zh: 例如在第 3 页搜索一个文件，只剩 1 条结果，如果还停留在第 3 页，用户看到的会是空列表。删除最后一页的最后一项也是类似情况。排查“明明有资料却搜不到”时，应先检查筛选与页码状态，再检查接口。
paragraphs.en: Searching for one file from page three may leave a single result. Keeping page three would display an empty list. Removing the last item on the final page creates a similar problem. Filter and page state are worth checking when an existing file seems to disappear.

title.zh: 查找和详情，尽量别打断当前工作
title.en: Keep search and details close to the current task

paragraphs.zh: 学院归档现在可以点击文件名打开详情侧栏，查看备注和驳回原因；Ctrl / ⌘ + K 可以查找功能和本地资料。结果列表支持方向键移动。快捷键之外还保留了可点击的搜索入口，手机端也能打开。
paragraphs.en: The archive demo opens a details drawer from the filename, including remarks and rejection reasons. Ctrl / ⌘ + K searches features and local files, and arrow keys move through results. A visible search button also gives phone users access.

paragraphs.zh: 快速查找只展示部分匹配项，不能把它当成完整检索清单。需要逐项核对时，仍应进入归档列表使用组合筛选。公开版文件和审核操作保存在访问者当前浏览器；多人通讯另需部署服务。
paragraphs.en: Quick Find returns a limited set of matches, so it is not a complete inventory. Use the archive list and its combined filters for a full review. Public-demo files and review changes stay in the visitor’s browser; collaboration needs a separate service.

title.zh: 接下来验收时，我会沿着这些操作走一遍

paragraphs.zh: 这类页面最容易在连续操作时出问题。下面是一组建议检查，用来核对界面提示与实际数据范围是否一致。
paragraphs.en: These interfaces are most revealing when actions are combined. The following checks compare the displayed scope with the records actually affected.

bullets.zh: 在两页各勾选一条，再导出，核对文件里的 ID、按钮数量和报告范围是否一致。
bullets.en: Select one record on each of two pages, export them, and compare IDs with the button count and report scope.

bullets.zh: 修改筛选条件，使其中一条不再匹配，检查失效的勾选是否清除，数量是否更新。
bullets.en: Change a filter so one selected record no longer matches, then check selection cleanup and the count.

bullets.zh: 停在较后的页码再搜索；清空结果后重置筛选；删除最后一页的最后一项。
bullets.en: Search from a later page, reset after an empty result, and remove the last item on the final page.

bullets.zh: 在手机宽度和键盘操作下打开详情、退出详情、重新查找，确认焦点和当前条件仍然可理解。
bullets.en: Open and close details and repeat a search at phone width and with a keyboard, checking focus and the active conditions.
